channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Elemis Skin Therapies
channel.desc: Care for your mind and body holistically and sensuously with therapeutic aromatherapy. Elemis are famed for their premier spa and salon treatments, and for the absolute purity of their plant oils.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Wellbeing Heroes
channel.desc: Discover Wellbeing Heroes - top picks to help you feel your best every day. Explore essentials for mind, body, and soul, and boost your daily wellness routine.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Aveda
channel.desc: For more than two decades, Aveda has combined nature and science to create pure plant and flower-based products for your hair.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: SKINN Skincare
channel.desc: Everyone deserves access to skincare innovations, which is why the SKINN brand creates formulas with a scientific approach, to promote lifelong beauty and wellness.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Ultrasun Professional Suncare
channel.desc: Ultrasun have the answer to your summer holidays with once-a-day suncare protection. Tune in to find out which product is best for you and your family all year round.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Glamorous Beauty with Liz Earle
channel.desc: Indulge yourself with pampering beauty products, including make-up, skincare and more, featuring iconic British botanical beauty brand, Liz Earle.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Menopause Your Way
channel.desc: Join Jackie Kabler as she chats to our panel of experts and founders about the menopause, helping you navigate midlife on your terms. From inspiring stories to game-changing products, tune in today.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Laura Geller Make-up
channel.desc: Laura Geller is a renowned make-up artist, teacher and working mother and the creative force behind one of the most successful make-up studios in New York. Join us to explore her superb range.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Shay & Blue Boutique Fragrance
channel.desc: Established in 2012, Shay & Blue is an award-winning boutique perfumery based in London's Marylebone that brings a contemporary twist to artisan fragrance.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Discovery
channel.desc: Discover a world of beauty at QVC, featuring a variety of new brands, luxurious skincare and cosmetic must-haves as well as tried and tested favourites.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Percy and Reed Haircare
channel.desc: Percy and Reed brings you new haircare products you always needed but could never find and they only create products which work - bringing British individuality and their own style to your hair.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Doll10 Beauty
channel.desc: the pioneer in age reversal beauty and a combination of breakthrough technologies, age transforming complexes and real life make-up techniques.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Loves...
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see our exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to love.
